data.description: The Dumbo Spring Rider is one of our character spring riders, finished in Green. Like the others in the range, it carries one small child on a steel spring, and children rock or bounce it while holding on. Spring riders are simple, low and gentle, which makes them a safe-feeling first ride for toddlers. Societies and play schools often buy two or three different characters so that children can choose their favourite. If you are planning a toddler corner, the Dumbo Rider can sit beside our duck, horse or dinosaur riders. Its roto-moulded body has a 3-year warranty and the spring a 1-year warranty. Ask us for a photo and a quote.

items.pText: The Dumbo Spring Rider is one of our character spring riders, finished in Green. Like the others in the range, it carries one small child on a steel spring, and children rock or bounce it while holding on. Spring riders are simple, low and gentle, which makes them a safe-feeling first ride for toddlers. Societies and play schools often buy two or three different characters so that children can choose their favourite. If you are planning a toddler corner, the Dumbo Rider can sit beside our duck, horse or dinosaur riders. Its roto-moulded body has a 3-year warranty and the spring a 1-year warranty. Ask us for a photo and a quote.

Its body is roto-moulded and fixed to a steel spring. We install it self-standing or with grouting. Keep the ground around the rider clear and soft, check the spring for wear and the base bolts for tightness during maintenance, and replace a worn spring promptly.
